title: broker-wired deployable hosting a broker-bound durable channel and an unbound durable channel with a local reactor
note: the unbound durable event must ride the outbox and be redelivered in-process, not run inline because the deployable wires a broker.  On java the broker relay and the local relay share __loom_outbox and partition it by event type; the compile tier checks that both relays and the per-type claim queries build.

apiCaller.e2eLess: BROKER SIDECAR: the four real-process behavioural legs cannot boot a broker-wired deployable without a broker URL (#5613), and the redelivery is asynchronous, which the `test e2e` vocabulary cannot wait on.  The compile tier and test/generator/channel-consumer-wiring.test.ts carry the wiring.
